title: Fresh Orange Sherbet
summary: Fresh orange and lemon juice sweetened with zest-scented sugar, whisked into softly whipped cream and churned into a light, creamy sherbet.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
light corn syrup or glucose syrup

steps.title: Make zest sugar
steps.text: Rub the zest into the sugar and salt with your fingertips until the sugar is damp, orange-tinted and fragrant.

steps.title: Dissolve
steps.text: Whisk in the orange juice, lemon juice and corn syrup, and keep whisking for about 3 min until no grains of sugar remain.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Strain into the medium bowl and chill until very cold, about 4 °C: 30-60 min in the freezer, stirring now and then. Do not let it freeze.

steps.title: Add the cream
steps.text: Whip the cream to soft peaks in the large bowl. Pour in the cold juice in a thin stream, whisking constantly, so the mixture stays smooth.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn straight away for 25-30 min until it has the texture of soft serve.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Pack into the container, press baking paper on the surface and freeze for at least 3 h. Leave for 5-10 min before scooping.

tips: Freshly squeezed juice gives the brightest flavour; you need about 6 oranges.
The juice must be very cold before it meets the cream, or the cream can split.
Blood oranges give a pretty pink sherbet.
storage: Keep frozen and covered for up to 1 week.
